download_error_runtime: The download stopped because its browser process ended. Return to the website to download it again.
download_error_source: The source of this download could not be read. Return to the website to download this file again.
download_reason_source: The download source could not be read
download_resume_help: Retry Download can resume this interrupted transfer for up to five minutes while its tab stays open.
download_resume_file_busy: Close other applications using this file or folder, then use Retry Download. The interrupted transfer expires after five minutes or when its tab closes.
update_status_manual: Version {version} needs to be installed manually from its release page.
settings_work_screenshot_sites_desc: Work may send pictures of these sites' pages to your model. This doesn't let it sign in or change anything.
settings_work_screenshot_unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the change. Pictures stay off for this site.
work_ask_screenshot_title: Let Work look at pages on {site}?
work_ask_screenshot_note: When the page's text isn't enough, Work sends a picture of the page to your model.
settings_material_fallback: Showing {material}: this system can't use your choice right now.
general_login_help: Zephium starts when you log in to this computer.
general_login_approval: Allow Zephium in System Settings › General › Login Items to finish.
general_login_failed: Zephium couldn’t change this. Try again, or use your system’s settings.
tabs_external_help: Where a link opens when another app hands it to Zephium.
tabs_close_buttons_help: Show a tab’s close button when you point at it, or on every tab.
look_preview: Preview of the window in this theme
look_theme_desc: Every theme has a light and a dark look, and Mode picks between them.
look_editing_desc: Each theme keeps its own light and dark colors.
look_hex_invalid: Enter a color as six hex digits.
look_contrast_desc: How far apart surfaces and text tones sit.
look_import_hint: Paste a theme someone copied from Zephium.
look_save_failed: Your theme couldn’t be saved. Try again.
look_tint_desc: How much of the theme’s color tints the glass.
look_font_desc: The face for the sidebar, menus and Settings.
look_size_desc: Text in the sidebar, menus and Settings. Rows keep their height.
look_code_font_desc: For code blocks and shortcut keys. Fonts you’ve installed appear here.
look_accent_desc: Follow the theme, or pick a color for controls and selections.
ai_switch_on: Work mode and its agents, the models they run on, and dictation.
ai_switch_off: Off. Zephium is just the browser, and everything you set up for Work is kept.
ai_switch_section_description: Work mode, its agents, and what they may see of the pages they read.
ai_switch_confirm_body: These leave Zephium until you turn them back on. Nothing is deleted.
ai_switch_leaves_work: Work mode and the Browse and Work switch
ai_switch_leaves_models: Your models and keys, which stay saved but unused
ai_switch_leaves_settings: Models, Skills, Memory, Site access and Connections in Settings
profiles_list_note: Each profile keeps its own sign-ins, history, tabs, extensions and Work. Your Zephium account is shared by all of them.
profiles_create_body: A separate place to browse, with its own sign-ins, history and Work.
profiles_delete_body: Its history, cookies and site data, tabs, extensions and Work are permanently removed from this device. Your Zephium account is not affected.
profiles_delete_default: The default profile can’t be deleted.
profiles_delete_current: Switch this window to another profile to delete this one.
profiles_avatar_unsupported: That picture can’t be used. Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
account_welcome_body: One account for Zephium AI and your devices, and for sync when it arrives. Zephium works fully without one.
account_avatar_crop_desc: It shows wherever you’re signed in to this account.
account_avatar_crop_help: Drag to reposition. Scroll or use the slider to zoom.
account_avatar_frame_label: Photo position. Arrow keys move it; plus and minus zoom.
account_avatar_unsupported: That picture can’t be used. Choose a still PNG, JPEG or WebP.
account_fault_avatar_invalid: That picture couldn’t be read. Try another one.
account_fault_avatar_timeout: The upload took too long. Try again.
account_fault_avatar_too_large: That picture is too big to upload. Try a smaller one.
account_fault_avatar_unsupported: Choose a still PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.
account_fault_avatar_dimensions: That picture has too many pixels. Resize it, then try again.
account_fault_avatar_processing: That picture couldn’t be prepared. Try another, or a smaller copy.
account_fault_avatar_busy: Photos are busy right now. Try again in {seconds}s; your current photo hasn’t changed.
account_prices_before_tax: Prices exclude tax, which is added at checkout.
section_features_description: Choose what Zephium includes. Turn something off and it leaves the app; nothing is deleted.
feature_ai_on: Models, the agents that work in Work, and dictation.
feature_ai_off: Off. No model runs, and your keys stay saved.
feature_work_on: A workspace beside your browser, for you and your agents.
feature_work_off: Off. Zephium is just the browser, and your Work is kept.
feature_tasks_on: Plan your day in a list beside your tabs.
feature_time_on: See where your time on the web goes, and run focus rounds.
feature_time_off: Off. Nothing is recorded, and past time is kept.
feature_confirm_body: It leaves Zephium until you turn it back on. Nothing is deleted.
feature_ai_leaves_models: Your models and keys, which stay saved but unused
feature_ai_leaves_settings: Models, Skills, Memory, Site access and Connections in Settings
feature_work_leaves_mode: Work mode and the Browse and Work switch
model_key_needed: Add your {provider} key to use its models here.
model_key_refused: {provider} refused the key. Add a working one in Settings.
model_hosted: Zephium’s hosted models, no keys needed.
space_theme_own: The window wears {name} while you are in this space.
space_save_failed: The space could not be saved. Try again.
space_empty_body: Tabs you open here stay with this space.
work_ai_off_note: Agents are off while AI is off.
space_new_failed: A new space could not be made. Try again.
model_effort_max_hint: Thinks as long as it takes
model_effort_fixed_hint: This model decides how long it thinks
model_server_needed: Connect a server of your own, such as Ollama or LM Studio, to use its models here.
model_empty: No models to choose from here yet.
launcher_shortcut_needs_modifier_windows: Hold Ctrl, Alt or Windows with the key, so it doesn’t type.
model_favourites_empty: Star a model to keep it here.
account_plans_desc: Pick the plan that fits how you use Zephium.
account_plan_feature_free_1: Full browser with Work and agents
account_plan_feature_free_2: Your own keys or local models
account_plan_feature_pro_1: Every model except Fable and Astra
assist_fault_no_answer: Zephium came back with nothing to say. Try again, or ask another way.
assist_fault_step_failed: A step on the page didn’t work.
assist_refusal_no_model_help: Zephium needs a model. Pick one, or add a key.
assist_refusal_unsupported: Pages can’t be read on this system
assist_refusal_unsupported_help: Zephium can’t read open pages here yet. Page styles you’ve made still apply.
assist_consequence_destructive: This deletes or cancels something on {site}.
assist_style_full: This site already holds as many styles as it can. Remove one to add another.
assist_fault_loading: This page is still loading. Ask again in a moment.
assist_cite_missed: Couldn’t find that on the page.
assist_step_refused: Zephium doesn’t type into passwords or follow links to other sites
assist_step_unsuitable: That isn’t something this step can use
native_unsaved_changes_message: Some changes in Notes, Tasks or Work could not be saved. Go back to retry or resolve a conflict, or quit anyway and lose them. Changes in another profile can only be saved from that profile.
account_vault_fault_mac: Zephium can’t read your sign-in from the Keychain, so Zephium AI and your account details can’t be reached. Sign in again to fix it.
account_vault_fault_windows: Zephium can’t read your sign-in from Windows Credential Manager, so Zephium AI and your account details can’t be reached. Sign in again to fix it.
pref_general_startup_pages_help: Opened in order each time Zephium starts, up to 10. With none added, Zephium continues where you left off.
pref_general_home_help: Where the Home command goes. Leave it empty to open a new tab instead.
pref_network_proxy_help_mac: Applies to tabs opened from now on, private ones included. Tabs already open keep their connection until they reload.
pref_network_proxy_address_help: Host and port, like proxy.example.com:3128. Without a valid address Zephium uses the system proxy.
network_proxy_address_invalid: Use the form host:port, like proxy.example.com:3128.
privacy_clear_history_help: Visited pages, searches, time on sites, recently closed tabs and chats.
privacy_clear_cookies_help: Signs you out of most sites. Includes data sites keep on this device.
privacy_clear_cache_help: Frees space. Pages may load more slowly at first.
privacy_clear_downloads_help: Forgets the list of downloads. The files stay on your disk.
privacy_clear_private: A private window keeps nothing to clear.
privacy_sites_help: See which sites stored cookies and data, and remove them one by one.
privacy_sites_description: Sites that stored cookies or data in this profile.
privacy_sites_partial: Only sites that stored cookies are listed here. Clear browsing data removes everything.
privacy_sites_load_failed: Couldn't list the sites. Try again.
privacy_sites_empty_help: Sites you visit appear here once they store something.
privacy_sites_remove_failed: Couldn't remove the data of {site}. Try again.
privacy_sites_remove_all_confirm: Remove cookies and data for all sites? You'll be signed out of most of them.
site_data_clear_description: Removes the cookies and data {site} stored in this profile. You'll be signed out of it. Open tabs keep running.
page_permission_private: Private windows don't save this choice.
page_permission_location_off: Turn on Location Services for Zephium in System Settings › Privacy & Security.
